mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a collapsing housing sector and labor market, triggering broad economic slowdown expectations that drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 2.0% YoY) signals sustained corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: regime:late-cycle expansion AND RSAFS growth > 2.0% YoY
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion with RSAFS growth > 2.0% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate aggressive monetary tightening without immediate labor market impact, causing market anticipation of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During strong labor market regimes, payroll growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
